headline: 英國新戲《故事》佳評
context: 倫敦國家劇院的新戲《The Story》，由蕾媞霞．萊特（Letitia Wright）飾演一名野心勃勃、卻在追逐新聞頭條中逐漸妥協原則的年輕記者，劇評形容手法俐落又充滿張力。同時，威尼斯影展也放映了一部關於已故導演德瑞克．賈曼（Derek Jarman）拍攝《愛德華二世》幕後過程的紀錄片，影評稱讚它是一部溫暖動人的時代側寫。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: National Theatre, London Letitia Wright plays the ambitious young reporter seduced into cutting corners with contentious reporting in a brilliantly kinetic production Tracey Scott Wilson’s play follows in the fine tradition of the fast-paced newsroom drama, beginning with the cold-blooded murder of a white schoolteacher by an unknown Black assailant as his pregnant wife watches. Cue moral panic, rolling news and the entry of a fiery young journalist determined to solve the case. That is where the Watergate-style investigative blueprint warps because Yvonne (Letitia Wright, of Black Panther fame) is no simple hero in pursuit of truth. She is an ambitious Black woman, assigned to an enclave of a newspaper reserved for Black journalists. Her imperious editor, Pat (Lorraine Toussaint) is after positive news stories on the Black community while her white editor boyfriend, Jeff (Wilf Scolding) promises her a bigger gig if she proves herself worthy. Continue reading...
sources.title: The Story review – thrilling drama of race, truth and the pursuit of headlines

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Venice film festival : Filmed during the making of his queer royal feature, while the director was living with HIV, the candid footage includes uproarious scenes at a Cliff Richard rehearsal There could hardly be a more vivid time-capsule film about the publicly funded British arts scene in the early 1990s than this engrossing fly-on-the-wall documentary about Derek Jarman and his movie Edward II. Based on the play by Christopher Marlowe, it is about the 14th-century English king and his love affair with his court favourite, Piers Gaveston, with Steven Waddington and Andrew Tiernan as the leads and Tilda Swinton as Queen Isabella. This film uses the tremendously funny and candid making-of footage shot at the time by Seamus McGarvey, who had worked as a camera assistant on earlier Jarman films War Requiem and The Garden, and whose distinguished career as a cinematographer lay ahead. Jarman emerges as an effortless leader with a beaming patrician authority, rather like David Lean or Richard Attenborough, the kind of chief whom subordinates instinctively wish to please while keeping from him the grubby problems that they themselves have to deal with, such as paying quarrelsome extras or handling tabloid press questions. Jarman had had his HIV diagnosis for five years at this stage, managing the situation with meds which McGarvey’s camera notices. Continue reading...
sources.title: Queer Edward II review – funny, touching time capsule of Derek Jarman at work

thread_text:
倫敦國家劇院的新戲《The Story》，由蕾媞霞．萊特（Letitia Wright）飾演一名野心勃勃的年輕記者，在追逐新聞頭條的過程中逐漸妥協了原則，劇評形容整齣戲節奏俐落、張力十足。同時，威尼斯影展放映了一部紀錄片《Queer Edward II》，記錄了已故導演德瑞克．賈曼（Derek Jarman）在確診HIV期間拍攝《愛德華二世》的幕後過程，影評形容它風趣又動人，是一部珍貴的時代側寫。

—— 本館報來自 The Guardian 新聞，於 2026 年 9 月 4 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 倫敦有一齣新戲很受好評。國家劇院的《故事》，由萊特飾演一名野心勃勃的年輕記者，在追逐新聞頭條的過程中，一步步妥協了自己的原則，劇評形容它節奏俐落、張力十足。同時，威尼斯影展也放映了一部紀錄片，記錄已故導演賈曼確診愛滋病毒期間，拍攝電影《愛德華二世》的幕後過程，影評形容它風趣又動人。
